architectural_notes: Ensure TREY-C security service/process is running as part of deployment/runtime health checks.
known_issues: Home screen 'Order Now' button(s) not working.
Other app buttons intermittently not working.
TREY-C security is not running (needs to be restarted/restored).

existing_features.title: Fix the Home (Landing) page CTA buttons (including the "Order Now" button) so they reliably navigate to the intended routes and never appear unclickable due to layout/overlay issues.

Replace the current placeholder/unavailable TREY-C security UI in the Admin panel with a functional dashboard that reads real security config/stats/events from the backend and allows admins to manage security settings.
Implement and display a working TREY-C security protection modal/banner component (currently empty) in a way that does not interfere with clicking underlying buttons/links.

new_feature_requests.summary: Audit and fix any other non-working buttons/CTAs across the app by ensuring each interactive element has a valid handler (navigate, submit, mutation) and is not accidentally disabled or blocked by an overlay; prioritize primary conversion/navigation buttons in the header and marketing pages.

Restore and implement "TREY-C security" as a working feature: add backend security state + APIs for enabling/disabling protection, rate limiting configuration, capturing security events, and exposing security stats/events to admins.

projectName: Fix non-working Home 'Order Now' and restore TREY-C security functionality
